c74object.name: lp.vim
c74object.description: lp.vim computes a mutant between a source (left inlet) and a target value with one of several interval mutation algorithms. The mutation index omega sets how far the result is from source towards target.

objarg.name: options
objarg.digest: Algorithm (usim, isim, uuim, iuim, wcm, lcm) and rel or abs

method.name: float
method.description: In the left inlet: Source value (outputs the mutant). In the 2nd inlet: Target value. In the 3rd inlet: Mutation index omega (0-1). In the 4th inlet: Clumping factor pi (0-1). In the 5th inlet: Delta emphasis (-1 to 1).

method.name: hard
method.digest: Clumping with a fixed run length
method.description: Clumping with a fixed run length.

method.name: int
method.description: In the left inlet: Source value (outputs the mutant). In the 2nd inlet: Target value. In the 3rd inlet: Mutation index omega (0-1). In the 4th inlet: Clumping factor pi (0-1). In the 5th inlet: Delta emphasis (-1 to 1).

method.name: rel
method.digest: Use relative intervals (default); an optional float sets the delta emphasis
method.description: Use relative intervals (default); an optional float sets the delta emphasis.

method.name: strict
method.digest: No clumping: decide for every value whether it is mutated
method.description: No clumping: decide for every value whether it is mutated.

method.name: tattle
method.digest: Print the state of the object to the Max Console (double-click does the same)
method.description: Print the state of the object to the Max Console (double-click does the same).

method.name: tight
method.digest: Clumping: keep the mutation state for runs of the given length
method.description: Clumping: keep the mutation state for runs of the given length.
